reviewer_added_requests.discovery_reason: The AI extension explicitly requires least privilege, confirmation, auditability, and recovery for side-effecting agent tool calls, while this candidate owns profile and tool authority plus sandbox decisions. The lightweight boundary cannot establish whether product-runtime tool governance and ChangeForge execution governance are cleanly separated, so full material is needed to test duplication, handoff, and unsafe gaps.

The AI extension treats indirect prompt injection, permission-blind retrieval, consequential model failures, and unauthorized tool instructions as first-class failure paths. This candidate owns protected assets, trust boundaries, reachable abuse paths, control placement, bypass analysis, and residual ownership. Full material is needed to compare those responsibilities and verify that the extension neither leaves nor duplicates the threat-model boundary.
